executiveSummary: The 213 distinct scanned forms contain 110 positive, 92 mixed and 10 negative assessments; one earlier cropped form remains unclear. The latest supplied period, 14–20 September, adds 33 forms: 18 positive, 14 mixed and 1 negative. Praise centres on staff service and enjoyable stays. Food variety (19 forms), service speed (15) and the access road (12) remain frequent specific concerns. Six forms now report pests, including three new cockroach reports; two earlier forms raise room-lock security issues. Prompt checks are warranted. The new batch also raises food freshness, water availability and housekeeping concerns. Good or excellent ticks often coexist with complaints. Figures come from scans only; supplied reporting-period labels are not verified response dates. Date discrepancies are disclosed, and the first entry still has no scans.

insights.title: Check room locks promptly
insights.detail: Two distinct forms in the 31 Aug–6 Sep batch report room-lock problems. One explicitly describes the issue as a security concern. These are guest reports, not verified maintenance findings.
insights.recommendation: Inspect and test affected locks using the private source records, check other guest-room locks, and record repairs and follow-up.

insights.title: Investigate pest reports
insights.detail: Six distinct forms across three reporting periods report pests. The latest batch adds three cockroach reports involving rooms, with two also mentioning the restaurant. These are guest reports requiring verification; favourable ratings elsewhere do not cancel them.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the reported spaces, review pest-control and cleaning records, address entry points and verify follow-up results.

insights.title: Broaden food choice and keep options available
insights.detail: Food variety is flagged on 19 forms; availability on 6. Requests include buffet and drink choices, later menu availability and breakfast supplies. Counts overlap and should not be added as unique guests.
insights.recommendation: Review buffet rotation and stock planning; communicate unavailable dishes before orders, and assess a limited late-evening menu.

insights.title: Improve speed and keep guests informed
insights.detail: Service speed is flagged on 15 forms. Earlier comments include requests for food-ready calls and a form that praises prompt staff while marking speed as needing improvement. Both favourable and adverse evidence are retained.
insights.recommendation: Track order-to-service time, agree who notifies guests when orders are ready, and review breakfast readiness and table clearing.

insights.title: Repair missing or nonworking room essentials
insights.detail: Amenities are flagged on 13 forms and room maintenance on 11, with overlap. New reports include bathroom-door positioning, drainage and a nonworking room phone.
insights.recommendation: Use a room-readiness checklist for amenities, television, hot water, shower and leaks. Track reported faults through resolution.

insights.title: Improve the arrival experience
insights.detail: The access road is flagged on 12 forms, and wayfinding on 5. The latter includes signs and directions within or approaching the property.
insights.recommendation: Assess road repairs with the responsible parties and add clear approach signs and arrival directions.

insights.title: Review food quality and portions
insights.detail: Food temperature is flagged on 5 forms, freshness on 5, portions on 8 and flavour on 7. New comments describe tasteless food and stale or dry meat. These are guest reports, not confirmed food-safety findings; category counts overlap.
insights.recommendation: Review food holding and service routines, investigate freshness reports and standardize portions against what guests are offered.

insights.title: Preserve the hospitality guests value
insights.detail: Explicit praise includes service on 34 forms, staff friendliness on 8 and professionalism on 4. Categories overlap; positive ticks alone do not count as written praise.
insights.recommendation: Recognize the behaviours guests praise and use them in coaching, alongside the specific service concerns.

insights.title: Keep the setting and enjoyable stays central
insights.detail: Explicit comments praise the overall experience on 58 forms and ambience on 12. Some of the same forms also request improvements.
insights.recommendation: Preserve the welcoming setting while addressing the concrete concerns listed in mixed feedback.
